name: Ruinn Sacculi
original_name: ルイーネ・サーキュリー
source: One of the Yun Gasol Union Three Musketeers. She came up with a way to counter Malucia, responsible with internal affairs and diplomacy Ruinn is very skilled in art of conversation and uses her clever smile without fail. She is also childhood friend of Gualandross. Ruinn finds her enjoyment in living for king and is trying to grant him his wish.
